column1: # Editable reading policy; titles require an immediately following capitalized name
# (St. Louis -> Saint Louis, Mt. Everest -> Mount Everest, Ft. Worth -> Fort Worth).
# Terminal/street Dr. and St. (Oak Dr., Main St.) and a lone A. are deliberately
# preserved: the street name before them may be in an earlier stream segment.
# No. 5 number five: only before a number (No. I will not stays).
# Existing undotted initialisms keep their text spelling by default.
# Options: preserve, letters (g p u), names (gee pee you).
# Unknown ALL-CAPS words never acquire an English spelling pronunciation by default.
# Speech mode spells an inferred initialism, unless the run reads as an English
# word (NASA, FIFA, EXCEL). The syllable tables below decide that.
# a SCSI is said as a word, an LED letter by letter (the article; 2026-10-08).
# Word-initial clusters of ordinary words written in capitals (CHRIST, SCHOONER,
# KNOT, GHOST) and word-final doubled letters and digraphs (STILL, LIGHT, SEARCH, TOWN).
# Consonant clusters that may start a syllable.
# Consonant clusters that may end a syllable.
# An abbreviation that is unambiguous without its period. st, dr, sr, no and pp
# are deliberately absent: the same sample reads st as saint and as street.
# Marks that carry a sentence on after an initial, so the initial's own period
# can be dropped: "Cossette , M. , Lecomte". A sentence end is not listed.
